title: Weighted impurity drop
statement_md:
`gini(labels)` already scores a node's impurity. Add `split_gain(parent, left, right)` for one candidate cut.

Return the **weighted** drop in impurity:

`I(parent) - (n_L/n) I(left) - (n_R/n) I(right)`

A child may be empty (impurity `0.0`). Return a `float`. Do not change `gini`.
